finding: Local-state-loss discovery ignored unknown states and accepted contradictory state/phase responses; unapproved payload fields in list responses were returned to caller. No automatic write was permitted, but recovery reporting and metadata privacy were insufficient.
fix: Validate list row shape, unique bounded operation IDs, state/phase combinations and allowed metadata fields; reject unexpected payload or malformed optional metadata. Validate status phase before returning state; explicitly deny execute for empty discovery too.

regression.warning: Existing canonical harness subprocess ResourceWarning remains.

limitations: Not deployed or independently reviewed. Discovery remains read-only and manual content reconciliation is required after local state loss.
No live access to settings, authentication, secrets, ACL, 165 business rows or audit.
Old-key rejection, live recovery, durable sixty-minute observation and formal QA remain incomplete.
next: Review discovery response contract with signed read-only probe before approved live integration; do not enable recovery APIs or clear communication stop.
